model: Altivar Process ATV630 / ATV600 family (Modbus serial and Modbus TCP)
applies_to: Altivar Process ATV600 drives (ATV630, ATV650 and other ATV6x0 models) on the embedded RJ45 Modbus serial port or the embedded Ethernet Modbus TCP server; register map per Communication Parameters file EAV64332 V4.6.
summary: Schneider Electric's process/pump variable frequency drive family with Modbus RTU on an RJ45 port and a Modbus TCP server on the embedded Ethernet port. Both use the same decimal logical addresses, sent unchanged as holding-register addresses. This map covers the CiA402 command/status words (CMD/ETA), frequency and speed references, the main monitors (motor frequency, current, voltages, DC bus, thermal states, power), energy counters, fault/warning codes, I/O states and the Modbus, Ethernet and channel settings.

addressing.note: Logical addresses are decimal (the parameter file also shows hex as 16#....) and go into the request unchanged. The Modbus serial manual's read example asks for W3102-W3105 by sending starting address 0C1E hex (= 3102) and writes W9001 at 2329 hex. All drive data are holding registers. On Modbus TCP use unit ID 0 or 248 for the drive; unit ID 255 reaches the Ethernet I/O scanner instead.

source.title: ATV600 - Communication Parameters (Excel)
source.pages: Sheet 'Parameters' (code, logic address, type, unit, access), sheet 'Registers' (CMI/CMD/ETA/ETI/CRC/CCC/IL1R/OL1R bits), sheet 'Enumerations' (HMIS, LFT, CHCF, ECFG, PSA, CDX, TBR, FOR, INR, STT). Also: Altivar Process ATV600 Modbus Serial Link Manual EAV64325 (11/2014) pp. 24-27 CMD/ETA, pp. 36-38 functions and examples, pp. 51-55 settings, p. 100 SLL; Embedded Ethernet Manual EAV64327 (10/2017) pp. 25-26 unit IDs and functions, p. 45 ttOb, p. 82 EtHL; Programming Manual EAV64318.14 p. 107-108 LCR step.

notes: Further sources: ATV600 Modbus Serial Link Manual EAV64325 rev 01, https://download.schneider-electric.com/files?p_Doc_Ref=EAV64325 ; ATV600 Embedded Ethernet Manual EAV64327 rev 03, https://download.schneider-electric.com/files?p_Doc_Ref=EAV64327 ; ATV600 Programming Manual EAV64318.14 (05/2026), https://download.schneider-electric.com/files?p_Doc_Ref=EAV64318 .
LCR (3204) is left unscaled: the parameter file defers to the programming manual, which gives a 0.01 A step for drives up to 15 kW, 0.1 A from 18 to 160 kW and 1 A above.
LFR (8502) and RFR (3202) are 0.1 Hz only while CMI bit 9 = 0 (power-up default); with bit 9 = 1 they become a signed value where 32767 = tFr.
ACC/DEC are raw values; their resolution follows INR (9020): 0 = 0.01 s, 1 = 0.1 s (factory), 2 = 1 s.

Left out: all 32-bit values (RTH/PTH run and power-on time 3244/3246, energy saved, fan time, today/yesterday kWh) because none of the documents states the word order; NCR and ITH (current step depends on rating); EPRW, OPRW, IPRW, ILN, AI physical values, PID reference/feedback and pump sensor values (unit 'refer to programming manual' or set by configurable system units).

OC0-OC4 and IC0-IC4 are R/WS in the parameter file (writable only when stopped, e.g. to reset). Energy is split into 16-bit 0-999 registers per decade: total motor energy = OC4 TWh + OC3 GWh + OC2 MWh + OC1 kWh + OC0 Wh, input energy likewise with IC0-IC4.
Registers marked RW that the source lists as R/WS can only be written while the drive is not running.
LFT and DP0-DP3 use the full LFT list (135 codes) and LALR the full ALR list (112 codes) from the parameter file Enumerations sheet.
Left out: IPR (3218, input power estimate) because the parameter file types it as signed 16-bit but gives an unsigned 0-65535 % range.
None of the sources states the Modbus TCP port number, so tcp_port is left null (502 is the usual Modbus TCP port but is not confirmed here).

bits.9: Remote: command or reference via network

registers.name: LCR - Motor current
registers.description: Raw; step 0.01 A up to 15 kW, 0.1 A 18-160 kW, else 1 A.

registers.name: ETI - Internal status word
registers.description: Accel/decel, current limit, control source, fault-cleared flag.

bits.2: In Fault state, cause gone but not yet reset
bits.13: Control source, with bit 14: bit 13 only set = remote keypad; neither set = terminals
bits.14: Control source, with bit 13: bit 14 only set = Modbus; both set = CANopen or network card

registers.name: OL1R - Logic output states
registers.description: Writable when the output is unassigned.

registers.name: SLL - Modbus error response
registers.description: Reaction to SLF1 timeout; factory freewheel.

registers.name: ETHL - Embedded Ethernet error response
registers.description: Reaction to ETHF timeout; factory freewheel.

registers.name: LFT - Last error
registers.description: Code of the most recent error (full LFT list from the parameter file).

values.6: Internal communication interruption with option module (ILF)

registers.name: DP0 - Error record 0 code
registers.description: Error history; same code list as LFT.

registers.name: CHCF - Profile (control mode)
registers.description: Factory SIM. Write only when stopped.

registers.name: CD1 - Command channel 1
registers.description: Used when CHCF = SEP or IO. Factory TER.

registers.name: CRC - Active reference channel
registers.description: One bit set for the channel giving the reference.

registers.name: CCC - Active command channel
registers.description: One bit set for the channel giving commands.

registers.name: CMD - Command word
registers.description: CiA402 control word (or I/O-profile bits when CHCF = IO).

bits.2: CiA402: Quick stop (0 = quick stop active)
bits.8: CiA402: Halt (stop per Stt, stays in Operation enabled)
bits.11: CiA402: assignable, default reverse direction (rrS = C111)

registers.name: LFR - Frequency reference
registers.description: Signed, 0.1 Hz while CMI bit 9 = 0; range -500.0 to 500.0 Hz.

registers.name: PISP - PID setpoint from network
registers.description: Range 0-1000; used when PID reference comes from Modbus.

registers.name: CMI - Extended control word
registers.description: Save to EEPROM, factory reset, LFR unit select.

bits.1: Save configuration to EEPROM (drive stopped only)
bits.15: 1 = parameter consistency check off (drive locked in stop)

registers.name: ACC - Acceleration time
registers.description: Unit set by INR; factory 100 = 10.0 s at INR 0.1 s.

registers.name: DEC - Deceleration time
registers.description: Unit set by INR; factory 100 = 10.0 s at INR 0.1 s.

registers.name: OC0 - Motor energy consumed, Wh part
registers.description: 0-999 Wh; add OC1-OC4 for the total.

registers.name: OC1 - Motor energy consumed, kWh part
OC2 - Motor energy consumed, MWh part
OC3 - Motor energy consumed, GWh part
OC4 - Motor energy consumed, TWh part
IC0 - Input energy, Wh part
registers.description: 0-999 Wh; add IC1-IC4 for the total.

registers.name: NM1 - Com scanner input 1 value
registers.description: First of the scanner input values (default ETA, RFRD).

registers.name: NC1 - Com scanner output 1 value
registers.description: First of the scanner output values (default CMD, LFRD).

registers.name: LALR - Last warning
registers.description: Code of the most recent warning (ALR list).

values.110: Fieldbus communication loss fallback channel is active (AFFL)

registers.name: IM00 - Embedded Ethernet IP mode
registers.description: Factory DHCP. A change takes effect at the next power-up.

integration.summary: Give the drive a Modbus address (serial) or an IP address (Ethernet), set FR1 to Modbus (164) or Embedded Ethernet (171) with CHCF = SIM, then write CMD (8501) = 0006h followed by 000Fh with a non-zero LFR (8502, 0.1 Hz). Poll ETA (3201), RFR (3202), LCR (3204), HMIS (3240) and LFT (7121).
integration.enable: Serial: set [Modbus Address] Add ([Communication] COM- / [Comm parameters] CMP- / [Modbus SL] MSL-; logical 6001) to 1-247 and restart the drive - the factory value is OFF. Baud and format default to 19200, 8-E-1. Ethernet: [IP mode Eth Embd] IM00 defaults to DHCP; enter a fixed IP (IC01-IC04, mask, gateway) or use BOOTP/DHCP, effective at next power-up. For combined CiA402 control set [Ref.1 channel] Fr1 = Modbus (Mdb) or Embedded Ethernet (ETH) with [Profile] CHCF = [Not separ.] SIM (factory); for separate mode CHCF = SEP and Cd1 = the network channel; for the I/O profile CHCF = IO and Cd1 = the network channel.
integration.watchdog: Serial: [Modbus Time Out] ttO (6005), 0.1-30 s, factory 10 s, raises SLF1; reaction set by [Modbus Error Resp] SLL (7010). Ethernet: [Ethernet Timeout] ttOb (64415), 0.1-30 s, factory 10 s, raises ETHF; reaction set by [Eth Error Response] EtHL (7021). Both offer freewheel (factory), ramp, fast stop, DC injection, ignore, per Stt, fallback speed LFF (7080) or maintain speed. A channel is only monitored once it has written a command or reference.
quirks: Addresses are decimal logical numbers sent as-is (3201 = 0x0C81); do not subtract 1 or add 40001.
Modbus TCP: unit ID 0 or 248 addresses the drive; 255 addresses the I/O scanner. Function 06 is only accepted on unit IDs 0-248.
CiA402 sequence: 0006h (shutdown) to Ready to switch on, then 000Fh to run; 0007h stops, 0000h disables voltage, 0080h rising edge resets a fault.
Both CMD and the reference must be written at least once before the drive enters Operation enabled.
Mask ETA with 006Fh: 0040h switch on disabled, 0021h ready, 0023h switched on, 0027h operation enabled, 0007h quick stop.
Serial functions: 03 (63 words), 06, 16 (61 words), 23 (20+20 words), 43/14, 08. Ethernet: 03 and 16 up to 63 words, 23 up to 32+32 words.
CMD bit 11 is reverse direction by default ([Reverse assign.] rrS = C111).
setup: Modbus serial RJ45 behind the front cover: pin 4 = D1, pin 5 = D0, pin 8 = common, pin 7 = 10 V for converters.
2-wire RS-485 up to 1000 m at 19200 bps, up to 31 drives per segment without repeater; terminate both ends with 120 ohm in series with 1 nF.
Restart the drive after setting Add - the manual says the address only takes effect after a restart.
Ethernet IP settings live under [Communication] COM- / [Comm parameters] CMP- / [Ethernet Embd] EtE-; a manually entered IP other than 0.0.0.0 disables BOOTP/DHCP.
Keypad counters M1CT (6011) and M1EC (6010) show received frames and CRC errors on the serial line.
gotchas: Factory Add = OFF: the drive ignores serial requests until an address is set and the drive restarted.
Factory IP mode is DHCP: without a DHCP server or a fixed address the Ethernet port has no IP.
Read LCR knowing the drive rating: the same raw number means 0.01 A, 0.1 A or 1 A depending on power size.
Ignore (NO) in SLL/EtHL turns off communication-loss protection; commissioning only.
CMI bit 1 saves to EEPROM (about 100,000 write cycles); do not set it cyclically.
